#Annalie.face.sad
Her face says it all…
No wonder, I can’t imagine her being thrilled about her shop getting wrecked.
You: Hi Annalie, are you alright? I saw what happened to your shop…
Annalie: Yeah… {{wi}}These weren’t the best couple of days…
Annalie: I’m in a huge debt because of it and my clients, even regulars seem to have abandoned me…
Damn…{{wi}} I should’ve gone here sooner… {{wi}}I could’ve helped her…
You: Sorry that I didn’t come here sooner.
#Annalie.Eyes.smileClosed+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Annalie: Don’t worry. I’m sure you had your own troubles during that time.
#Annalie.face.sad
